descriptionFull: The red-backed shrike ( Lanius collurio ) is a carnivorous passerine bird and member of the shrike family Laniidae. The genus name, Lanius , is derived from the Latin word for "butcher", and some shrikes are also known as "butcher birds" because of their feeding habits. The specific collurio is from Ancient Greek kollurion , a bird mentioned by Aristotle. The common English name "shrike" is from Old English scríc , "shriek", referring to the shrill call.
